verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's own vault health reports cover part of this story: they evaluate vault security and include named Reused Passwords and Weak Passwords reports run locally on the client. The evidence shows these as reports the user runs, not proactive warnings, and it never mentions breached-service or exposed-password detection. Missing for 10: evidence of breached-website or exposed-password (breach database) detection, proactive alerts or notifications rather than on-demand reports, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, the app warns me when a service I use is breached or a stored credential is weak, reused, or exposed

citations.quote: Reports, such as the Reused Passwords and Weak Passwords report, are run locally on your client
Vault health reports can help you evaluate the security of your Bitwarden individual or organization vault
